description: Add an outline around the subject of an image whose background was removed (remove_background first): the cutout's visible edge is traced into a new vector element placed directly above the image, aligned with its crop, rotation, flip and scale; stroke only, no fill, outside stroke, round joins (the sticker look). The outline is an ordinary element afterwards (restyle, move or delete it). `ids`: the image element ids (or #refs; a frame, group or instance id reaches the cut images inside it). `color`: optional #RRGGBB stroke color (default plain white). `width`: optional stroke width in px (default 2 percent of the image's short edge). Answers the new outline id per image, or the honest refusal (no removed background, nothing visible to trace, a tiled image). Runs locally: no Brilliant AI usage.

anyOf.description: Element IDs (or #refs) of images whose background was removed. Required.

ids.description: Element IDs (or #refs) of images whose background was removed. Required.

name: add_cutout_outline
